verdict.rationale: Supabase auto-generates REST/GraphQL APIs from the schema, ships a CLI for local dev, an OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server that lets AI agents query and manage projects programmatically (supabase-docs-1/13/18, supabase-gh-2, supabase-probe-3/4). However, community evidence indicates some operational workflows (e.g., production database edits, branching/preview environments) are still steered toward the Dashboard rather than a fully API-driven path, and even Supabase's own co-founder cautions against using the Dashboard for production changes while migration/branching tooling is still maturing (supabase-comm-6/7/8). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a full Management API covering project/org-level admin actions (billing, project creation, backups) with parity to Dashboard, and independent confirmation that AI agents can perform all UI actions (not just query/read) without guardrail restrictions.
